text:
STATE PERSONNEL SUMMARY > Full-Time Equivalent Positions by Agency for Fiscal Years 2026 and 2027 1/

3/ Includes 970.3 FTE Positions in FY 2026 and FY 2027 in the Other Fund FTE Positions columns funded from Expenditure Authority.

4/ Includes 2,474.1 FTE Positions in FY 2026 and 2,723.6 FTE Positions in FY 2027 in the Other Fund columns funded from the Long Term Care System Fund, Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program Fund, and Child Support Enforcement Expenditure Authority.

5/ Of the 364.0 FTE Position increase in FY 2027, 21.0 are new FTE Positions, 387.0 are FTE reclassified from non-appropriated Federal Funds to General Fund or Expenditure Authority, and (44.0) are for the elimination of one-time Adult Protective Services (APS) funding.

6/ The FY 2026 General Appropriations Act originally appropriated 17,994.1 FTE Positions to the Universities for FY 2026. This FTE Position amount has been revised to 17,189.8 to account for changes in projected tuition and fee collections. Any revised tuition rates as well as changes in enrollment can result in collections exceeding (or being below) the appropriated amount.

7/ The Other Fund FTE Positions are funded by the University Collections Fund, which includes a portion of tuition and fees and a portion of land earnings.
